headline: Wardens Press Stlican Shelf Gains; Two Works Lie in Ruin
war_summary: Since our last edition the Wardens have pressed their recovery of the Stlican Shelf, now holding seven of its nine strongpoints, one more than at the previous count, though the pace there has eased — four actions in the past two hours against twenty-two in six, and forty-six in the day, The Pale House alone witnessing eighteen. Weathered Expanse has flared anew: five actions in the past two hours, nineteen at Spirit Watch in a day, and Warden casualties running well ahead of the Colonial rate. For the first time on our count two works lie demolished — one in the Dead Lands, where Callahan's Boot took eight blows, the day's toll neared 19,900, and the last action fell as this edition closed — and one in Godcrofts, where Argosa saw six. Stonecradle's grind persists about The Long Fast, ten events; Callahan's Passage flared at The Latch, which passed through several hands before the Wardens held all ten once more. Linn of Mercy bleeds without pause, near 7,700 casualties in a day, yet not one base action there. On the full board the Colonials hold 260 works to the Wardens' 174, two in ruin. It is the 164th day; thirty-four victory towns remain the prize, and no victor is named.
